annotations.title: Update fields on a Merchant Center product

description: Change SOME fields on a product already in a Merchant Center feed — the everyday operation, because price and availability move daily. This is a PATCH: only the attributes you name are touched and everything else on the product survives, which is the difference from upsert_merchant_product (a whole-row write that wipes anything you leave out). It refuses if the product does not exist rather than quietly creating a half-populated one, and it refuses an empty change rather than sending an update mask with nothing behind it. The reply reports every field Google now holds, so you can see what survived. Free.

additionalImageLinks.description: extra image URLs, sent as the whole list

ageGroup.description: newborn, infant, toddler, kids or adult

attributes.description: any other product attribute by its Merchant API name

contentLanguage.description: two-letter language code; taken from the feed when it declares one

dataSource.description: the feed it lives in, from list_merchant_data_sources

description.description: new product description; omit to leave unchanged

feedLabel.description: market label, e.g. US; taken from the feed when it declares one

identifierExists.description: false for a product with no GTIN, MPN or brand, such as a service or bundle

itemGroupId.description: shared id that groups the variants of one product

link.description: product page URL on the merchant's store

price.description: new price: {value in major units or amountMicros, currencyCode}

amountMicros.description: micros, if you already have them — 1 unit = 1000000

productTypes.description: merchant-defined category labels, as a list

salePrice.description: new sale price, same shape as price

amountMicros.description: micros, if you already have them — 1 unit = 1000000

title.description: new product title; omit to leave unchanged

name: update_merchant_product
